facts.fact: Niger's Minister of Communication, speaking on 22 October 2025, cited ordinance no. 2011-22 of 23 February 2011 on the charter of access to public information and administrative documents as an existing initiative to give journalists, researchers, students and citizens reliable information; the date given is the ordinance's, 2011.
facts.system: Ordonnance n° 2011-22 du 23 février 2011 portant charte d'accès à l'information publique et aux documents administratifs
